title: Minecraft NEW Bonemeal Farm Tutorial - Self Sustaining - 9000 P/H!
description:
In this Tutorial I Will Show you how to make a Super Efficient and simple Bone Meal Farm Based On Moss Blocks 4x times faster and that is self-sustaining! In Minecraft

📚This Bonemeal Farm is so fast and can produce +9000 Bonemeals Per Hour!
📚This bonemeal farm is self-sustaining!
📚It's so easy to build you can build this farm only in 30 - 40 minutes!
📚Unfortunately because of some game mechanics, this farm doesn't work on the bedrock edition

I Hope to Enjoy My Video !!🙏🥰
